name: KFin Technologies Ltd

ledger.quote: We are hopeful by end of the year, we will cross 10,000 mark and be the largest registrar by a mile.
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: Target to cross 10,000 corporate clients by end of year was not reported on the call.

ledger.quote: I expect that to happen most likely in the next 12 to 14 months.
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: Target for mutual fund industry to reach 1 trillion dollars by September 2026 was not updated.

ledger.quote: I'd like to believe that in the next 3 to 4 quarters, we should start seeing decent EBITDA contribution
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: NPS segment broke even and added over 15% EBITDA contribution within four quarters.
ledger.evidence: It is no longer a loss-making, but adds to about roughly 15% plus in terms of the EBITDA.

ledger.quote: we maintain an EBITDA margin of 41.5% which is in the range of guidance that we gave of 40% to 45%.
ledger.speaker: Vivek Mathur
ledger.verdict: FY26 EBITDA margin reached 41.0%, achieving the guided 40% to 45% range.

ledger.quote: I do not anticipate any further yield compression.
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: Yield compression recurred, with management reporting a 2% yield correction in Q1 FY27.
ledger.evidence: So, that is the reason why there is a 2% yield correction that happened in the Q1 even though the equity asset class remains stable.

ledger.quote: I think we will cross INR2 trillion by the next time I speak easily.
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: Target to cross INR 2 trillion AIF by next quarter was not confirmed on the call.

ledger.quote: and one that we are confident we will get close to 50% into the next 12 to 18 months.
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: AIF market share reached 37.3% with wins expanding toward the 50% target by May 2027.
ledger.evidence: it occupies a share of about 37.3%. The wins that we have, which are yet to launch, if we add that, we believe that the market share will be closing in on 40%.

ledger.quote: And with more scale in each of the operating geographies, it will turn -- the profits will be in single digits, I'd like to believe for this fiscal.
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: Ascent turned profitable in Q4 FY26 and maintained an 8.4% EBITDA margin in Q1 FY27.
ledger.evidence: In terms of the margin of the entity itself, it had already turned the corner into the previous quarter, as you heard from the Q4 of the previous year. This year, too, it continues to be around 8.4%

ledger.quote: And we have a very strong plan -- operating plan to get into double-digit margins into the next year.
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: Ascent double-digit margin target remains on track for delivery within the next 12 months.
ledger.evidence: we are working towards hoping to hit double-digit margin expansion by end of year

ledger.quote: And it is our intent and the stated commitment that we want as we grow other businesses much faster, would be able to reduce an overreliance on one asset class and one geography under 50% into the next couple of years.
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.target: reduce reliance on one asset class and geography under 50%
ledger.verdict: Non-MF revenue rose to 38%, progressing toward reducing single-segment dependency below 50%.
ledger.evidence: dependency on a singular business will come down to below 50% into the coming three years and if not, sooner.

ledger.quote: And as the acquisition of Ascent as we drive forward international expansion, I'm very confident that we will be in the top 3 into the next 5 years in terms of the total quantum of investors, volume of transactions as we handle
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: Goal to reach top 3 position in global investors and transactions within 5 years remains ongoing.
ledger.evidence: As we could clearly see over the past five years, our revenue has increased manifold

ledger.quote: So whilst you do not see Ascent numbers kind of meeting KFintech's into immediate future, but it is definitely a 3-year plan, thus we believe we can get that far.
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: Reaching KFintech EBITDA margin levels at Ascent remains a 3 to 5 year target.
ledger.evidence: coming to EBITDA margin of KFin Tech level, it will take about three to five years.

ledger.quote: We believe that we'll continue to maintain that guidance going forward as well.
ledger.speaker: Vivek Mathur
ledger.verdict: FY26 revenue grew 19.2% with 41.0% OPM, meeting revenue and margin guidance ranges.
ledger.evidence: Revenue Mar 2026 was 1301.0 vs Mar 2025 1091.0 (19.2% growth); OPM % was 41.0%

ledger.quote: We aim to cross -- we aim to get to close to 11,500 into this upcoming year
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: Added 670 clients in Q1 FY27 towards the 11,500 corporate client target for FY27.
ledger.evidence: Issuer solutions, we have added 670-odd clients into the previous quarter.

ledger.quote: organic revenue to grow a little over 60% plus into this year
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: Organic international revenue grew 32% in Q1 FY27 against full-year target of 60% plus.
ledger.evidence: just the KFin's organic business has grown over 32%.

ledger.quote: overall international revenue to be a little over 70%, including that of Ascent
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: Total international revenue including Ascent grew nearly 200% YoY in Q1 FY27, exceeding 70%.
ledger.evidence: In terms of international business, obviously with the Ascent’s expansion, we have grown nearly 200% year-on-year.

ledger.quote: look in spite and despite of what's happening in the market and the global uncertainties we have, we believe that we have a reasonable line of visibility to get to about 23% to 24% top line growth into the coming year.
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: Revenue grew 30.3% in Jun 2026 and 30.1% in Sep 2026, tracking ahead of 23-24%.
ledger.evidence: Revenue YoY % was 30.3% in Jun 2026 and 30.1% in Sep 2026

ledger.quote: EBITDA, we expect it to be around 16% to 17% and a PAT little around 10% growth is what we expect to see into the coming year.
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: Management raised FY27 growth targets to 17-20% for EBITDA and 12-15% for PAT.
ledger.evidence: we have visibility for EBITDA growth closer to 20%, anywhere between 17% to 20%, and our PAT numbers anywhere between 12% to 15%.

ledger.quote: organically, we believe we have line of visibility to grow close to about 15% and the PAT a little over 11%.
ledger.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella
ledger.verdict: Organic revenue grew 10% in Q1 FY27 towards full-year organic growth target of 15%.
ledger.evidence: Excluding Ascent also, we have grown nearly 10% thereabouts, EBITDA grew about 7% plus

open.quote: We do believe that the fast outperformance of each of these businesses would mean the dependency on a singular business will come down to below 50% into the coming three years and if not, sooner.
open.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella

open.quote: We do believe that into the Q2, notwithstanding, we are working towards hoping to hit double-digit margin expansion by end of year, and subsequently, depending upon the pipeline that we have, continue to add at least finite basis points every single year from there on
open.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella

open.quote: We will maintain 40% threshold including Ascent by the end of this year.
open.speaker: Vivek Mathur

open.quote: EBITDA margins will be in the range of 40% to 45%.
open.speaker: Vivek Mathur

open.quote: we have visibility for EBITDA growth closer to 20%, anywhere between 17% to 20%, and our PAT numbers anywhere between 12% to 15%.
open.speaker: Sreekanth Nadella

read: Management delivers on financial revenue growth and annual EBITDA margin commitments, but yield predictions miss due to asset mix shifts. Ongoing revenue diversification away from domestic mutual funds is progressing as promised.
questions: Why did yield compress 2% in Q1 FY27 despite earlier guidance of no further yield compression?
What is the updated status and timeline for crossing 10,000 corporate clients and INR 2 trillion AIF?
When will Ascent achieve double-digit EBITDA margins given Q1 FY27 margins stood at 8.4%?
bull: Revenue grew 30.3% YoY in Jun 2026 and 30.1% in Sep 2026, driven by international expansion.
NPS segment achieved EBITDA profitability, contributing over 15% EBITDA margin in Q1 FY27.
Non-MF revenue share expanded to 38% in Q1 FY27, reducing core segment concentration.
bear: Q1 FY27 OPM % dropped to 34.0% consolidated due to Ascent integration costs.
Yield compressed 2% in Q1 FY27 from shift in product mix toward liquid funds.
PAT declined 2.6% YoY in Jun 2026 quarter to Rs 75 crore due to higher D&A costs.
